data.titulo: Oshitopolwa 3—Okuza Emanguluko muEgipiti sigo Omukwaniilwa gwoTango gwaIsrael
data.contenido:
Moses okwa wilike Aaisrael okuza muupika muEgipiti sigo okOndundu yaSinai, hoka Kalunga e ya pe iipango ye. Konima Moses okwa tumu aalumentu 12 ya ka ndaadhe oshilongo shaKanaan. Ihe 10 yomuyo oya galuka nehokololo ewinayi. Oya halitha aantu ya shune kuEgipiti. Molwuunkundi weitaalo lyawo, Kalunga okwa geele Aaisrael moku ya endaenditha uule woomvula 40 mombuga.

Lwahugunina, Josua okwa hogololwa okufala Aaisrael moshilongo shaKanaan. Oku ya kwathela ya yuge ko oshilongo, Jehova okwa longo iikumithalonga. Ye okwa thikameke omeya gOmulonga gwaJordan, a mbonyokelitha omankolokuma gaJeriko mumwe, nokwa thikamitha etango esiku alihe. Konima yoomvula hamano, oshilongo osha yugwa Aakanaan.

Okuza pethimbo lyaJosua, Israel okwa pangelwa uule woomvula 356 kaatokolihapu. Tse otatu ilongo oyendji yomuyo, mwa kwatelwa Barak, Gideon, Jefta, Simson naSamuel. Tse otatu lesha wo kombinga yaakiintu ngaashi Rahab, Debora, Jael, Rut, Naomi naDelila. Oshitopolwa OSHITITATU otashi kwatele mo oomvula 396 adhihe kumwe dhondjokonona.

OTO vulu mbela okuhokolola kutya aantu otaa toola shike pevi? Otashi monika sha fa omume. Osho oshitokele, noshishuushuu nuudhulumutu. Ihe kashi shi omume; osho sha shokuliwa.

Konyala omwedhi owala gwa piti po okuza sho Aaisrael ya thigi po Egipiti. Yo oye li mombuga. Muka ohamu mene iikulya iishona, nomolwashono aantu taa nyenyeta taa ti: ‘Tse otwa halele Jehova e tu dhipage muEgipiti. Hoka tse otwa li tu na iikulya oyindjiyindji sha pitilila.’

Ano Jehova ota ti: ‘Ngame otandi ka lokitha iikulya okuza megulu.’ Naashika osho Jehova ta ningi. Ongula ya landula, sho Aaisrael ya mono iinima mbika iitokele mbyoka ya gu, yo otaa pulathana: ‘Oshike shika?’

Moses ota ti: ‘Shika osho iikulya mbyoka Jehova e mu pe okulya.’ Aantu otaye yi luku OMANNA. Oyi na omulyo gwa fa gwoshikuki shomagadhi goonyushi sha pepuka.

‘Omu na okutoola ye eleka kehe gumwe ngaashi to vulu okulya,’ Moses osho ta lombwele oshigwana. Ano shika osho yo haa ningi ongula kehe. Sho etango tali pupyala, omanna ngoka ga hupu po pevi otaga hengumuka.

Moses ota ti ishewe: ‘Hagumwe ta pungulile esiku tali landula omanna.’ Ihe yamwe yomaantu itaya pulakene. Owa tseya kutya oshike tashi ningwa po? Ongula ya landula omanna ngoka yo ya pungula oga li gu udha omazinyo, notaga tameke okunika! Ihe opu na esiku limwe koshiwike, moka oshigwana hashi toola omanna ogendji lwaali, palombwelo lyaJehova. Olyo esiku etihamano. Jehova nota ti kutya yo oye na okwiipungulila gamwe gomugo sigo esiku tali landula, oshoka ye ita ka gwitha sha mesiku etiheyali. Sho yo taa pungula omanna sigo esiku etiheyali, itaga ningi omazinyo noitaga nika! Shika oshikumithalonga natango!

Oomvula adhihe ndhoka Aaisrael ye li mombuga, Jehova ote ya palutha nomanna. Eksodus 16:1-36; Numeri 11:7-9; Josua 5:10-12.

KONYALA oomwedhi mbali ko-nima sho yo ya thigi po Egipiti, Aaisrael oye ya pOndundu yaSinai, ndjoka yi ithanwa wo Horeb. Ndika olyo tuu ehala mpoka Jehova a popile naMoses moshihwa sha hwama. Oshigwana oshu ungu ontanda nosha kala mpaka okathimbo.

Manga oshigwana sha tegelela pevi, Moses ota londo kondundu. Pombanda kondungu yondundu Jehova ota lombwele Moses kutya Ye okwa hala Aaisrael ya vulike kuYe noya ninge oshigwana She shi ikalekelwa. Sho Moses te ya pevi, ota hokololele Aaisrael shoka Jehova a ti. Naantu otaa ti kutya yo otaa ka vulika kuJehova, oshoka yo oya hala okukala oshigwana she.

Ngashingeyi Jehova ota longo oshinima inaashi monika nale. Ye ota tsinitha ondungu yondundu olwithi, nota ndundumitha endundumo edhigu. Ye ota popi wo noshigwana: ‘Ongame Jehova Kalunga keni ngoka e mu tembudha muEgipiti.’ Opo nduno ye ote ya lombwele: ‘Kamu na okugalikana ookalunga yalwe kakele kangame.’

Kalunga ota gandja natango iipango nenge oompango omugoyi kAaisrael. Aantu oya tila noonkondo. Yo otaa ti kuMoses: ‘Ongoye u popya natse, oshoka tse otwa tila ngele Kalunga okwa popi natse tse otatu ka sa.’

Konima Jehova ota lombwele Moses: ‘Londa kondundu u ye kungame. Ngame otandi ke ku pa omayambi gomamanya gaali moka nda nyola oompango ndhoka nda hala oshigwana shi dhi dhiginine.’ Ano Moses ota londo ishewe kondundu. Ota kala hoka omitenya nomausiku 40.

Kalunga oku nine oshigwana she oompango odhindjidhindji. Moses ota nyola oompango ndhika. Kalunga ota gandja wo omayambi gomamanya gaali kuMoses. Kwaangaka, Kalunga okwa nyola ko ye mwene oompango 10 ndhoka ye a popi koshigwana ashihe. Ohadhi ithanwa Iipango Omulongo.

Iipango Omulongo oyo oompango dha simana. Ihe osho wo shi li oompango adhihe dhilwe ndhoka Kalunga a gandja kAaisrael. Shimwe shomoompango ndhino osho: ‘U na okuhola Jehova Kalunga koye nomutima gwoye aguhe, nomadhiladhilo goye agehe, nomwenyo gwoye aguhe nonoonkondo dhoye adhihe.’ Nashilwe osho: ‘U na okuhola omukweni ngaashi wi ihole mwene.’ Omwana gwaKalunga, Jesus Kristus, okwa ti kutya mbika oyo iipango iyali iinenenene mbyoka Jehova a gandja koshigwana she Israel. Konima tse otatu ki ilonga iinima oyindji kombinga yOmwana gwaKalunga nomalongo ge. Eksodus 19:1-25; 20:1-21; 24:12-18; 31:18; Deuteronomium 6:4-6; Levitikus 19:18; Mateus 22:36-40.

O! O! Ngashingeyi aantu otaa ningi nee ngiini ngeyi? Yo otaa galikana ontana! Omolwashike taye shi ningile?

Sho Moses a kala ethimbo ele kondundu, aantu otaa ti: ‘Tse katu shi wo shoka sha ningilwa Moses. Ano natu ningeni oshikalunga shoka tashi vulu oku tu kwatela komeho okuza moshilongo shika.’

‘Eewa,’ omumwayinamati gwaMoses Aaron ta ti. ‘Kuthii mo omagola geni giingoli momakutsi, nomu ge ete kungame.’ Sho aantu taye shi ningi, Aaron ote ga hengumuna nota ningi ontana yoshingoli. Aantu notaa ti: ‘Ndjika oyo Kalunga ketu, ngoka e tu kwatele komeho okuza muEgipiti!’ Opo nduno Aaisrael otaa ningi oshituthi oshinene notaa galikana ontana yoshingoli.

Sho Jehova te shi mono, ye ota geye noonkondo. Ano ota lombwele Moses: ‘Endelela nou kulukile pevi mbala. Aantu otaa longo nayi noonkondo. Yo oya dhimbwa oompango dhandje notayi inyongamene ontana yoshingoli.’ Moses ota kuluka kondundu te endelele. Naashono te ya popepi, osho shoka ye ta mono. Aantu otayi imbi notaa tanta taa dhingoloka ontana yoshingoli! Moses okwa geya ngaaka kutya a dhaadhige pevi omayambi gomamanya gaali ngoka ge na iipango, notaga tatuka muupambu owindji. Opo nduno ota kutha ontana yoshingoli note yi hengumuna. Te yi kweya nduno uusila.

Aantu oya ningi oshinima oshiwinayi noonkondo. Ano Moses ota lombwele yamwe yomaalumentu ya kuthe oma-gongamwele gawo. ‘Aantu aawinayi mboka ya galikana ontana yoshingoli oye na okusa,’ Moses ta ti. Aalumentu oya dhipaga aantu 3 000! Otashi ulike kutya tse otu na okusa oshimpwiyu opo tu galikane Jehova oye awike, nohaikalunga, hasho mbela? Eksodus 32:1-35.

OWA tseya kutya etungo ndino olyashike? Olyo etsali lyi ikalekelwa lyokugalikanena Jehova. Ohali ithanwa wo etsalihangano. Aa-ntu oya mana oku li tunga muule womvula yimwe konima sho ya thigi po Egipiti. Owa tseya mbela kutya osha li edhiladhilo lyalye oku li tunga?

Osha li edhiladhilo lyaJehova. Manga Moses a li kOndundu yaSinai, Jehova okwe mu lombwele nkene e na oku li tunga. Ye okwa ti kutya yo oye na oku li ninga ngaaka tali vulu okuza kumwe nuupu. Opo nduno iitopolwa tayi vulu okuhumbatwa okufalwa kehala lilwe, naahono otayi shunwa kumwe natango. Ano uuna Aaisrael taa tembuka okuza kehala limwe nokuya kehala lilwe mombuga, yo oya yi pamwe netsali ndyoka.

Ngele ngoye to tala meni lyokala okashona konima metsali, oto vulu okumona oshiketha. Ohashi ithanwa oshiketha shehangano. Osha li shi na aayengeli yaali nenge aakerubi ya ningwa moshingoli, kehe kondungu gumwe. Kalunga okwa nyola ishewe Iipango Omulongo komayambi gomamanya gaali, oshoka gotango Moses okwe ga tatula. Nomamanya ngaka oga pungulwa meni moshiketha shehangano. Omu na wo oshitenga shomanna sha pungulwa meni lyayo. Oto dhimbulukwa mbela kutya omanna oshike?

Jehova ota hogolola Aaron omumwayina gwaMoses a kale omusaaseri omukuluntu. Oye ta kwatele oshigwana komeho megalikano lyasho kuJehova. Noyanamati oyo wo aasaaseri.

Ngashingeyi tala kela enene lyetsali. Enene lwiikando iyali li vule okala okashona. Ou wete oshiketha oshishona, mono tamu tsinagana olwithi? Osho oaltari moka aasaaseri haa fikile sha shi na ezimba ewanawa hashi ithanwa etsinino. Opu na wo oshihukikwanyeka shi na oolamba heyali. Noshinima oshititatu mela osho oshitaafula. Kusho ohaku pungulwa omihi 12 dhoomboloto. Molugumbo lwetsalihangano omu na etemba enene lyu udha omeya. Aasaaseri ohaye li longitha okwiiyogela mo. Omu na wo oaltari onene. Muka iinamwenyo ya sa omo hayi fikilwa oyo eyambo lyaJehova. Etsali oli li naanaa pokati kontanda, nAaisrael oya kala momatsali gawo ge li dhingoloka. Eksodus 25:8-40; 26:1-37; 27:1-8; 28:1; 30:1-10, 17-21; 34:1, 2; Aaheberi 9:1-5.

TALA kiiyimati mbyoka aalumentu mbaka ya humbata. Tala owala nkene ehila ndyoka lyomandjembele enene. Aalumentu yaali oye na oku li humbata koshiti. Ihe tala owala koonkwiyu noondunga dhagranati. Openi pwa zi iiyimati mbino iiwanawa? Okoshilongo shaKanaan. Oto dhimbulukwa ndishi, Kanaan olyo ehala hoka Abraham, Isaak naJakob ya kala. Ihe molwondjala ndjoka ya li ko, Jakob nuukwanegumbo we oya tembukile kuEgipiti. Ano konima yoomvula 216 lwaampono, Moses ota kwatele Aaisrael komeho okushuna kuKanaan. Oye ya pehala mombuga lyi ithanwa Kades.

Aantu aawinayi oyo ya kala moshilongo shaKanaan. Ano Moses ota tumu ko oondaadhi 12 nota ti kudho: ‘Taleni kutya aantu yangapi ya kala mo, noye na oonkondo dhi thike peni. Taleni ngele evi ewanawa niimeno. Eteleleni alikana yimwe yomiiyimati ngele tamu galuka.’

Sho oondaadhi dha galuka kuKades, otadhi ti kuMoses: ‘Paushili wo wene osho oshilongo oshiwanawa.’ Nomoku shi ulika, yo otayu ulikile Moses iiyimati. Ihe 10 yomoondaadhi otaa ti: ‘Aantu mboka ya kala hoka oyo aanene noye na oonkondo. Otaye ke tu dhipaga ngele tse otatu kambadhala okuyuga ko oshilongo.’

Aaisrael oya tila sho taye shi uvu. ‘Osha li shi li hwepo ando okusila muEgipiti nenge no-kuli mpaka mombuga,’ yo taa ti. ‘Tse otatu ka dhipagelwa miita naakiintu naanona yetu otatu ke ya yugwa. Natu hogololeni omuwiliki omupe pehala lyaMoses tse tu shuneni kuEgipiti!’

Ihe yaali yomoondaadhi oyi inekela muJehova, notaa kambadhala okumweneka oshigwana. Omadhina gawo ogo Josua naKaleb. Yo otaa ti: ‘Inamu tila. Jehova oku li pamwe natse. Tse otatu ka yuga ko oshilongo nuupu.’ Ihe oshigwana itashi pulakene. Osha hala nokuli okudhipaga Josua naKaleb.

Shika otashi geyitha Jehova noonkondo, nota ti kuMoses: ‘Hagumwe gwomaantu mboka ye na oomvula 20 nenge dhi vulithe po, ta yi moshilongo shaKanaan. Yo oya mono iikumithalonga mbyoka ngame nda longo muEgipiti nomombuga, ihe natango inayi inekela ndje. Omolwashoka yo ye na okweendaenda uule woomvula 40 mombuga sigo omuntu gwahugunina ta si. OJosua naKaleb owala taya ka ya moshilongo shaKanaan.’ Numeri 13:1-33; 14:1-38.

TALA koongala noomandeli dha tiligana kondhimbo ndjika nenge koshiti shika. Oyo ondhimbo yaAaron. Oongala ndhino niiyimati oya mene owala muusiku wumwe kondhimbo yaAaron! Natu tale kutya omolwashike.

Pethimbo opo tuu mpoka Aaisrael oya kala ya tembauka nale uule wokathimbo mombuga. Aantu yamwe otaa dhiladhila kutya Moses ke na okukala omuwiliki, nenge kutya Aaron ke na okukala omusaaseri omukuluntu. Korah oye gumwe gwomwaamboka taa dhiladhila ngawo, nosho wo Datan, Abiram naapangeli 250 yoshigwana. Yo ayehe oye ya kuMoses noya ti: ‘Omolwashike wi itula po ngoye mwene oku tu pangela?’

Moses ota ti kuKorah naalanduli ye: ‘Ongula yanofu kutheni iitsininitho yeni nomu tule mo omatsinino muyo. Ileni nduno ketsalihangano lyaJehova. Tse otatu ka tala kutya Jehova ota hogolola lye.’

Esiku lya landula Korah naalanduli ye 250 otaye ya ketsalihangano. Yalwe oyendji otaye ya pamwe nayo okwaambidhidha aalumentu mbaka. Jehova okwa geya noonkondo. ‘Zeni mo moontanda dhaalumentu mbaka aawinayi,’ Moses ta ti. ‘Kamu na okuguma sha shawo.’ Aantu otaa pulakene, notaa zi mo moontanda dhaKorah, Datan naAbiram.

Opo nduno Moses ota ti: ‘Kwaashino ne otamu ka tseya kutya olye a hogololwa kuJehova. Evi otali ka makuka nokunina po aalumentu mbaka aawinayi.’

Mbala sho Moses ta hulitha okupopya, evi otali makuka. Ontanda yaKorah nomaliko ge naDatan naAbiram naayehe puyo oya gwile mo, nevi olye ya edhilile mo. Opo nduno aantu otayu uvu eigidho lyaamboka taa gwile moshilambo, taa igidha: ‘Matukeni! Evi mbela natse wo otali tu nina po!’

Korah naalanduli ye 250 oya thikama natango popepi netsalihangano. Ano Jehova ota tumu omulilo naayehe otaa lunguna po. Opo nduno Jehova ota lombwele omwanamati gwaAaron Eleasar a kuthe iitsininitho yaalumentu mboka ya sa noku yi ninga esiikilitho lya pepuka lyoaltari. Esiikilitho lyoaltari ndino oli na okukala elondodho lyAaisrael kutya hagumwe e na okulongela Jehova oye omusaaseri kakele kaAaron noyanamati.

Ihe Jehova okwa hala a holole sha yela kutya oyo Aaron noyanamati mboka a hogolola ya kale aasaaseri. Ano ye ota ti kuMoses: ‘Aapangeli yezimo kehe lyaIsrael naye ete ondhimbo. Kezimo lyaLevi ou na okweeta ondhimbo yaAaron. Tula ano oondhimbo adhihe ndhino metsalihangano komeho goshiketha shehangano. Ondhimbo yomulumentu ngoka ngame tandi mu hogolola oye omusaaseri otayi ka mena oongala.’

Sho Moses a yi a ka tale ongula ya landula, tala! oongala ndhika noomandeli dha tiligana odha mena kondhimbo yaAaron! Ou wete nee ngashingeyi kutya omolwashike Jehova a menitha oongala kondhimbo yaAaron? Numeri 16:1-35; 17:1-14 (16:36-49, OB-1986); 17:16-26 (17:1-11, OB-1986); 26:10.

OOMVULA otadhi piti po—oomvula 10, oomvula 20, oomvula 30, oomvula 39! NAaisrael onkene ngaa ye li natango mombuga. Ihe oomvula adhihe ndhino Jehova ota sile oshigwana she oshimpwiyu. Ye ote shi palutha nomanna. Omutenya ote shi kwatele komeho noluzigi lwoshikogo, nuusiku onoluzigi lwomulilo. Nopethimbo lyoomvula adhihe ndhino oonguwo dhawo itadhi kulupa noompadhi dhawo itadhi ehama.

Ngashingeyi ogwo omwedhi gwotango gwomumvo omuti-40 sho ya thigi po Egipiti. Aaisrael otayu ungu ishewe ontanda puKades. Opo tuu mpoka ya li sho oondaadhi 12 dha tumwa oku ka ndaadha oshilongo shaKanaan konyala oomvula 40 dha piti. Omumwayina gwaMoses Miriam okwa sile puKades. Mpaka opu na ishewe uupyakadhi ngaashi nale.

Aantu itaa vulu okumona omeya. Ano otaa nyenyetele Moses: ‘Ando otwa sile osha li hwepo. Omolwashike we tu kuthile muEgipiti we tu eta kehala ndino enyanyalithi ihaali mene sha? Kamu na iilya, kamu na oonkwiyu, kamu na omandjembele, kamu na oondunga dhomigranati. Kamu na nokuli omeya gokunwa.’

Sho Moses naAaron taa yi ketsalihangano oku ka galikana, Jehova ota ti kuMoses: ‘Ithana oshigwana shi gongale. Popya nduno montaneho yasho nemanya ndyoka. Otamu ka za omeya ga gwana oshigwana niinamwenyo yasho ayihe.’

Ano Moses oti ithana oshigwana shi gongale nota ti: ‘Pulakeneni, ne mboka inaamu inekela muKalunga! Ngame naAaron natu mu zithile omeya memanya ndika?’ Opo nduno Moses ota dhenge emanya lwiikando iyali nondhimbo nekunguluko enene lyomeya olya kunguluka okuza memanya. Opu na omeya ga gwana okunuwa kaantu ayehe niimuna.

Ihe Jehova ota geyele Moses naAaron. Owa tseya kutya omolwashike? Osho molwashoka Moses naAaron oya ti kutya yo otaa ka zitha omeya memanya. Ihe osha li lelalela oJehova ngoka e shi ningi. Nomolwashono Moses naAaron inaya hokolola oshili moshinima shino, Jehova ota ti kutya ye ote ke ya geyela. ‘Ne itamu ka fala oshigwana shandje muKanaan,’ ye ta ti.

Mbala Aaisrael otaa thigi po Kades. Konima yokathimbo otaye ya pOndundu yaHor. Aaron okwa sile pombanda yondundu ndjika. Ye okwa li e na oomvula 123 pethimbo lyokusa kwe. Aaisrael oya nika oluhodhi noonkondo, noshigwana otashi lili Aaron omasiku 30. Omwanamati Eleasar ota ningi omusaaseri omukuluntu a landula ko gwo-shigwana shaIsrael. Numeri 20:1-13, 22-29; Deuteronomium 29:4 (29:5, OB-1986).

OTASHI monika ndishi sha fa eyoka lyolela lyi idhingila koshiti? Halyo. Eyoka olya ningwa moshikushu. Jehova okwa lombwele Moses e li tule koshiti opo oshigwana shi vule okutala ko noshi vule okukala nomwenyo. Ihe omayoka galwe pevi oge na omwenyo. Go oga komona aantu noge ya ehameke. Owa tseya mbela kutya omolwashike?

Omolwashoka Aaisrael oya popi nayi Kalunga naMoses. Yo otaa nyenyeta: ‘Omolwashike we tu kuthile kuEgipiti tu ye tu sile mombuga? Muka kaamu na iikulya nenge omeya. Notwa vulwa noonkondo okulya omanna ngaka.’

Ihe omanna ogo iikulya iiwanawa. Jehova okwe ge ya pe okupitila moshi-kumithalonga. Nokwe ya pe wo omeya mokupitila moshikumithalonga. Ihe aantu inaa pandula omukalo ngoka Kalunga te ya sile nagwo oshimpwiyu. Omolwashono Jehova ta tumu omayoka ngaka guuzigo okugeyela Aaisrael. Omayoka otage ya komona noyendji yomuyo otaa si.

Lwahugunina aantu otaye ya ku-Moses notaa ti: ‘Otwa yono molwashoka otwa popi nayi Jehova nangoye. Galikana ngashingeyi kuJehova opo a kuthe po omayoka ngaka.’ Ano Moses ota galikanene oshigwana. Jehova nota lombwele Moses a ninge eyoka lyoshikushu ndika. Ota ti kutya oli na okutulwa koshiti, nakehe ngoka ta komonwa oku na okutala kulyo. Moses ota ningi naanaa ngaashi Kalunga ta ti. Naantu mboka taa komonwa otaa tala keyoka lyoshikushu notaa aluka ishewe.

Tse otatu vulu okwiilonga oshilongwa mwaashika. Momukalo gwontumba tseni atuheni ongaashi Aaisrael mbeyaka mboka ya komonwa keyoka lyoshikushu. Tse atuhe ohatu si. Tala momu-dhingoloko noto ka mona kutya aantu otaa kulupa notaya alukwa notaya si. Osho molwashoka omulumentu nomukiintu yotango, Adam naEva, oya thigi po Jehova, natseni atuheni aanona yawo. Ihe Jehova okwa ningi sha opo tseni tu vule okukala nomwenyo sigo aluhe.

Jehova okwa tumu Omwana, Jesus Kristus, kombanda yevi. Jesus okwe endjelelekwa koshiti molwashoka aantu oyendji oya dhiladhila kutya ye omwiinayi. Ihe Jehova okwa gandja Jesus e tu hupithe. Ngele tse tatu tala kuye nongele tse tatu mu landula, tse otatu vulu okumona omwenyo gwaaluhe. Ihe tse otatu ki ilonga nale oshindji kombinga yaashino. Numeri 21:4-9; Johannes 3:14, 15.

NGOYE owu uva nale mbela okasino taka popi? ‘Aawe,’ ngoye osho to ti. ‘Iinamwenyo ihayi vulu okupopya.’ Ihe Ombimbeli otayi hokolola okasino hoka ka popi. Natu tale kutya shika ongiini sha ningwa.

Konyala Aaisrael oyi ilongekidha okuya moshilongo shaKanaan. Balak, omukwaniilwa gwaMoab, okwa tila Aaisrael. Ano ye ota tumu omulumentu omunandunge gwedhina Bileam a ka thinge Aaisrael. Balak otu uvaneke a pe Bileam iimaliwa oyindji, ano Bileam ota londo okasino ke nota yi kuBalak.

Jehova ina hala kutya Bileam a thinge oshigwana She. Ano ota tumu omuyengeli e na egongamwele ele a thikame mondjila a keelele Bileam. Bileam ita vulu okumona omuyengeli, ihe okasino ke otaka vulu. Ano okasino otaka kambadhala nopwaa na oluthuwo ka ze po pomuyengeli, nolwahugunina otaka lala mondjila. Bileam okwa geya noonkondo, nota dhenge okasino ke noshiti.

Opo tuu mpono Jehova otu uvitha Bileam nkene okasino ke taka popi naye. ‘Onde ku ningi shike sho to dhenge ndje?’ okasino taka pula.

‘Ngoye oto ningi ndje egoya,’ Bileam ta ti. ‘Andola ngame onda li ndi na egongamwele, ando onde ku dhipaga!’

‘Onde ku ninga ngaa nale ngawo?’ okasino taka pula.

‘Aawe,’ Bileam ta ti.

Opo nduno Jehova ota monitha Bileam omuyengeli e na egongamwele a thikama mondjila. Omuyengeli ota ti: ‘Omolwashike wa dhengele okasino koye? Ngame onde ya ndi ku keelele, oshoka ngoye ku na oku ka thinga Israel. Andola okasino koye ka ka pungulukile, andola ngame onde ku dhipaga, ihe andola ngame inandi ehameka okasino koye.’

Bileam ota ti: ‘Ngame onda yono. Kanda li nda tseya kutya ongoye wa thikama mondjila.’ Omuyengeli te etha Bileam a ye, Bileam nota yi kuBalak. Ye ota kambadhala natango okuthinga Israel, ihe pehala lyaashono Jehova ote mu lalekitha Israel nuuyamba lwiikando itatu. Numeri 21:21-35; 22:1-40; 23:1-30; 24:1-25.

MOSES okwa hala a ye pamwe nAaisrael muKanaan. Ano ota pula: ‘Jehova, taagulukithe ndje Omulonga gwaJordan nondi mone oshilongo oshiwanawa.’ Ihe Jehova ota ti: ‘Sha gwana! Ino popya we kwaashino!’ Owa tseya kutya omolwashike Jehova e shi tile?

Osho molwashono sha ningwa po sho Moses a dhenge emanya. Dhimbulukwa kutya ye naAaron inaya simaneka Jehova. Yo inaya lombwela oshigwana kutya oye Jehova ngoka a li a zitha omeya memanya. Omolwashoka Jehova a ti kutya ye ite ke ya pitika ya ye muKanaan.

Ano oomwedhi dhimwe konima yeso lyaAaron Jehova ota ti kuMoses: ‘Kutha Josua, mu thikamitha ihe komeho gomusaaseri Eleasar nogoshigwana. Naahono komeho gawo ngoye ou na okulombwela ayehe kutya Josua oye omuwiliki omupe.’ Moses ota ningi naanaa ngaashi Jehova ta ti, ngaashi to vulu okumona mefano.

Opo nduno Jehova ota ti kuJosua: ‘Kala u na oonkondo, ino kala wa tila. Ngoye oto ka fala Aaisrael moshilongo shaKanaan shoka ngame nde shi ya uvanekele, ongame notandi ka kala pamwe nangoye.’

Konima Jehova ota lombwele Moses a londe pombanda sigo okondungu yOndundu yaNebo moshilongo shaMoab. Hoka Moses ota vulu okutala kombanda yOmulonga gwaJordan nokumona oshilongo shaKanaan oshiwanawa. Jehova ota ti: ‘Shika osho oshilongo shoka ngame ndu uvaneka oku shi pa aanona yaAbraham, Isaak naJakob. Otandi shi ku ulukile, ihe itandi pitika u ye mo musho.’

Moses oko a sile kombanda yOndundu yaNebo. Okwa li e na oomvula 120. Okwa li natango e na oonkondo nota vulu natango okumona ko nawa. Aantu oyu uvite oluhodhi noonkondo notaa lili molwashoka Moses a si. Ihe oya nyanyukwa sho Josua oye omuwiliki gwawo omupe. Numeri 27:12-23; Deuteronomium 3:23-29; 31:1-8, 14-23; 32:45-52; 34:1-12.

AALUMENTU mbano oye li muudhigu. Yo oye na okufadhuka po, ngele hasho otaa ka dhipagwa. Oyo oondaadhi Aaisrael, nomukiintu ngoka te ya kwatha oye Rahab. Rahab okwa kala megumbo li li menkolokuma lyoshilando Jeriko. Natu taleni kutya omolwashike aalumentu mbano ye li muudhigu.

Aaisrael oyi ilongekidha okutaaguluka Omulonga gwaJordan okuya moshilongo shaKanaan. Ihe tango Josua ota tumu mo oondaadhi mbali. Ye ota ti kuyo: ‘Indeni mu ka ndaadhe oshilongo noshilando shaJeriko.’ Sho oondaadhi tadhi ya muJeriko, otadhi yi megumbo lyaRahab. Ihe gumwe ota ti komukwaniilwa gwaJeriko: ‘Aaisrael yaali oye ya nena uusiku muka ya ndaadhe oshilongo.’ Omukwaniilwa sho te shi uvu, ye ota tumu aalumentu kuRahab notaye mu lombwele: ‘Eta mo aalumentu mboka ye li megumbo lyoye!’ Ihe Rahab oondaadhi okwe dhi holeka kontala yongulu ye. Ano ota ti: ‘Eeno, aalumentu oyi ile mpaka pegumbo lyandje, ihe kandi shi wo mpoka yo taa zi. Yo oya yi sho taku luudha, manga eyelo lyoshilando inaali patwa. Ngele otamu ningilile, otamu vulu oku ya kwata!’ Ano aalumentu oye ya landulilile po.

Konima Rahab ota yi mbalambala kontala yongulu. ‘Ngame ondi shi shi kutya Jehova oshilongo shika ote ke shi mu pa,’ ye ta ti koondaadhi. ‘Tse otu uvu nkene ye a kukutitha Efuta Etiligane sho mwa thigi po Egipiti, nonkene mwa dhipaga aakwaniilwa Sihon naOg. Ngame onda kala nane nombili, ano alikana uvanekelii ndje kutya otamu ka kala nangame nombili. Hupitheni tate nameme, naamwameme aalumentu naakadhona.’

Oondaadhi otadhi shi uvaneke, ihe Rahab oku na okuninga po sha. ‘Taamba ongodhi ndjika ontiligane yi dhitika pekende lyongulu yoye,’ oondaadhi tadhi ti, ‘nou ete iilyo yuukwanezimo woye ayihe megumbo lyoye. Nuuna tatu galuka okuyuga ko Jeriko, otatu ka mona ongodhi ndjika pekende lyoye nahagumwe ta ka dhipagwa megumbo lyoye.’ Sho oondaadhi tadhi galukile kuJosua, otadhi mu hokololele ashihe shoka sha ningwa po. Josua 2:1-24; Aaheberi 11:31.

TALA! Aaisrael otaa taaguluka Omulonga gwaJordan! Ihe omeya oge li peni? Oominute dhimwe dha tetekele omulonga ogwa li gu udha noonkondo, molwashoka omvula oyindji ohayi loko pethimbo ndyono lyomumvo kehe. Ihe ngashingeyi omeya agehe othilu! NAaisrael otaa taaguluka pevi ekukutu ngaashi naanaa kEfuta Etiligane! Omeya agehe oga yi peni? Natu tale.

Sho ethimbo lyAaisrael lya thikana okutaaguluka Omulonga gwaJordan, Jehova ota lombwelithitha oshigwana kuJosua tashi landula: ‘Aasaaseri ye na okukutha oshiketha shehangano noye ende ye li komeho getu. Uuna oompadhi dhawo tadhi lyata momeya gOmulonga gwaJordan, omeya otaga ka mwena okukunguluka.’

Ano aasaaseri otaa tumbu po oshiketha shehangano notaye shi humbata komeho gaantu. Sho taye ya puJordan, aasaaseri otaye ende naanaa momeya. Otage endelele noonkondo nomale. Ihe sho ngaa oompadhi dhawo tadhi lyata momeya, omeya otaga tameke taga mwena okukunguluka! Osho oshikumithalonga! Jehova okwa pwinike omeya ngoka kombanda. Ano mbala inamu hupa omeya momulonga! Aasaaseri mboka ya humbata oshiketha shehangano, otaye ende naanaa sigo opokati komulonga gwa kukuta. Oto vulu mbela oku ya mona mefano? Manga yo ya thikama mpeya, Aaisrael ayehe otaye ende pevi ekukutu taa taaguluka Omulonga gwaJordan! Sho ayehe ya piti, Jehova ota lombwelithitha Josua aalumentu aanankondo 12 ta ti: ‘Indeni momulonga mpoka aasaaseri ya thikama noshiketha shehangano. Tooleni omamanya 12 ga ndumbileni mpoka ne tamu ka lala nena. Uuna nduno aanona yeni taye mu pula monakuyiwa shoka omamanya ngaka taga ti, omu na okutya kutya omeya oga mwenene okukunguluka sho oshiketha shehangano shaJehova sha taagulukithwa Jordan. Omamanya otage ke mu dhimbulukitha oshikumithalonga shika!’ Josua ota ndumbile wo omamanya 12 mpoka aasaaseri ya li ya thikama mokati komulonga.

Lwahugunina Josua ota ti kaasaaseri mboka ya humbata oshiketha shehangano: ‘Londeni mu ze mo muJordan.’ Sho taye shi ningi, omulonga otagu tameke ishewe okukunguluka. Josua 3:1-17; 4:1-18.

OSHIKE tashi mbonyokelithitha mumwe omankolokuma ngaka gaJeriko? Otashi monika sha fa omboma onene ye ga mbomo. Ihe pethimbo ndyoka kapwa li oomboma; yo kaya li ye na nando odho oondjembo. Osho oshikumithalonga natango shaJehova! Natu tale nkene sha ningwa.

Pulakena shoka Jehova ta lombwele Josua: ‘Ngoye naakwiita yoye omu na okudhingoloka oshilando. Dhingolokeni oshilando uule womasiku gahamano oshikando shimwe esiku kehe. Naya humbate oshiketha shehangano pamwe nane. Aasaaseri yaheyali ye na okweenda komeho notaa hiki omankuma gawo.

‘Esiku etiheyali mu na okudhingoloka oshilando lwiikando iheyali. Hikeni nduno olule omankuma naayehe nayu uve eigidho enene lyiita tali uyagana. Nomankolokuma otaga ka gwa po thiluthilu!’



Josua noshigwana otaa ningi shoka Jehova ta ti. Manga yo taa dhingoloka, ayehe oya mwena. Hagumwe ta tumbula oshitya. Ashihe shoka to vulu okuuva osho omawi gomankuma neinyengo lyoompadhi. Aatondi yoshigwana shaKalunga muJeriko oya li ya tila shili. Oto vulu mbela okumona ongodhi ndyoka ontiligane ndyoka ye endjelela pekende? Ekende olyalye? Eeno, Rahab okwa ningi shoka oondaadhi mbali dha ti. Uukwanezimo we auhe ou li puye meni taa tala.

Lwahugunina, esiku etiheyali, sho yo ya dhingoloka oshilando lwiikando iheyali, omankuma taga hikwa, aakwiita taa uyagana nomankolokuma otaga mbonyokele mumwe. Opo nduno Josua ota ti: ‘Dhipageni ayehe ye li moshilando nomu shi fike po. Fikeni ayihe. Hupitheni owala oshisiliveli, oshi-ngoli, oshikushu noshiyela, yi ga-ndjeni koshiketha sheliko shetsali lyaJehova.’

Koondaadhi mbali Josua ota ti: ‘Indeni kegumbo lyaRahab, mu eteni mo nuukwanezimo we auhe.’ Rahab nuukwanezimo we otaya hu-pithwa, ngaashi naanaa oondaadhi dhu uvaneke. Josua 6:1-25.

TALA shoka omulumentu nguka ta fumvike metsali lye! Onguwo ombwanawa, elaka lyoshingoli niimaliwa iisiliveli yontumba. Ye okwe yi kutha moshilando shaJeriko. Ihe oshike sha li shi na okuningwa niinima yomuJeriko? Oto dhimbulukwa mbela?

Yo oya li yi na okuhanagulwa po, noshingoli noshisiliveli osha li shi na okufalwa koshiketha sheliko shetsali lyaJehova. Ano aantu mbano inaaya vulika kuKalunga. Yo oya yaka shoka shaKalunga. Omulumentu edhina lye oAkan, noku li pamwe niilyo yuukwanegumbo we. Natu tale shoka tashi ningwa po.

Konima sho Akan a yaka iinima mbino, Josua ota tumu aalumentu oyendji ya kondjithe oshilando shaAi. Ihe oya dhengwa. Yamwe oya dhipagwa, noshihupe otashi fadhuka po. Josua okwa yemata noonkondo. Ye ota lala noshipala she sha tsa pevi nota galikana kuJehova: ‘Omolwashike wa pitika tu shi ningilwe?’

Jehova ota yamukula: ‘Thikama! Israel okwa yono. Yo oya kutha iinima yimwe mbyoka yi na okuhanagulwa po nenge yi na okweetwa ketsalihangano lyandje. Oya yaka onguwo ombwanawa noya kala nayo meholeko. Ngame itandi ke mu laleka nuuyamba omanga yo nosho wo omufuthi inaamu ya hanagula po.’ Jehova ota ti kutya ye ote ku ulukila Josua olye ngoka omulumentu omwiinayi.

Josua oti ithana oshigwana shi gongale, Jehova notu ulike omulumentu omwiinayi Akan. Akan ota ti: ‘Ngame onda yono. Onda mono onguwo ombwanawa, elaka lyoshingoli niimaliwa iisiliveli. Onda li nde yi halelela ngaaka kutya ndi yi kuthe po. Onde yi fumvika metsali lyandje.’

Sho tuu iinima mbino ya monika noye etwa kuJosua, ye ota ti kuAkan: ‘Omolwashike we tu undulile omupya? Ngashingeyi Jehova ote ke ku undulila omupya!’ Opo tuu mpoka oshigwana otashi dhipaga Akan nuukwanegumbo we nomamanya. Otashi holola kutya tse katu na nando okukwata iinima mbyoka kaayi shi yetu, hasho mbela?

Konima Aaisrael otaa yi ishewe ya ka kondjithe Ai. Oshikando shika Jehova ota kwatha oshigwana she, notashi sindana. Josua 7:1-26; 8:1-29.

OYINDJI yomiilando yomuKanaan otayi ilongekidha ngashingeyi oku ka kondjitha Israel. Yo otayi dhiladhila kutya otayi vulu okusindana. Ihe aantu yoposhilando shopopepi Gibeon yo itaa dhiladhila ngawo. Yo oyi itaala kutya Kalunga ota kwatha Aaisrael, noinaya hala ya kondjithe Kalunga. Owa tseya kutya Aagibeon otaa ningi po shike ngashingeyi?

Yo otaa tokola oku shi monikitha sha fa ongo yo taa zi kokule. Ano yamwe yomaalumentu otaa zala oonguwo dha tuuka noongaku dha kulupa. Otaa londeke oompunda dha kulupa kuusino wawo, notaa kutha iikwiila iikulu ya kukuta ya ye pamwe nayo. Opo nduno otaa yi kuJosua notaa ti: ‘Tse otatu zi koshilongo shokokule, oshoka tse otu uvu kombinga yaKalunga keni omunene, Jehova. Tse otu uvu shoka ye e mu ningile muEgipiti. Aawiliki yetu oye tu lombwele tu longele iikulya yolweendo notu ye kune notu tye: “Tse aapiya yeni. Tu uvanekeleni kutya ne itamu ke tu kondjitha.” Ne otamu vulu okumona kutya oonguwo dhetu odha nyanyauka molwuule wondjila nonokutya iikwiila yetu oya kulupa noya kukuta.’

Josua naawiliki yalwe oyi itaala Aagibeon. Ano otayu uvaneke okwaahe ya kondjitha. Ihe konima yomasiku gatatu otaye shi mono mo kutya paushili wo wene Aagibeon oya kala popepi mpoka.

‘Omolwashike mwe tu lombwele kutya otamu zi koshilongo shokokule?’ Josua te ya pula.

Aagibeon otaa yamukula: ‘Tse otwe shi ningi oshoka tse otu uvu kutya Kalunga keni Jehova oku uvaneke okugandja oshilongo shika ashihe shaKanaan kune. Ano tse otwa li twa tila kutya otamu ke tu dhipaga.’ Ihe Aaisrael otaa gwanitha euvaneko lyawo noitaa dhipaga Aagibeon. Pehala lyaashono yo otaye ya ningi aapiya yawo.

Omukwaniilwa gwaJerusalem okwa geya molwashoka Aagibeon oya panga ombili naIsrael. Ano ye ota ti kaakwaniilwa yalwe yane: ‘Ileni nomu kondje pamwe nangame tu kondjitheni Aagibeon.’ Nosho shoka aakwaniilwa mbano yatano taa ningi. Aagibeon oya li mbela aanandunge okupanga ombili naIsrael, ndjoka ngashingeyi tayi eta sha shoka tashi ningitha aakwaniilwa mbaka ye ye oku ya kondjitha? Otatu ke shi mona nale. Josua 9:1-27; 10:1-5.

TALA kuJosua. Ye ota ti: ‘Etango, thikama thilu!’ Netango otali thikama thilu. Otali kala esiku alihe mpoka pokati kegulu. Jehova oye te shi ningitha! Ihe natu tale kutya omolwashike Josua a hala etango li kale tali minikile.

Uuna aakwaniilwa aawinayi yatano taya tameke okukondjitha Aagibeon moshilongo shaKanaan, Aagibeon otaa tumu omulumentu a ka pule ekwatho kuJosua. ‘Ila mbala kutse!’ ye ta ti. ‘Tu hupitha! Aakwaniilwa ayehe yokoondundu oye ya okukondjitha aapiya yeni.’

Josua naakwiita ye ayehe otaa yi mbalambala. Otaye ende uusiku auhe. Sho taya thiki puGibeon, aakwiita yaakwaniilwa yatano oya tila notaa tameke okuya ontuku. Opo nduno Jehova ota gwitha oompawe megulu, naakwiita oyendji ye vulithe mboka ya dhipagwa kaakwiita yaJosua otaa si molwashoka ya gumwa koompawe.

Josua oku wete kutya etango meni lyethimbo efupi otali ka ningina. Otaku ka luudha noyendji yomaakwiita yaakwaniilwa aawinayi yatano otaa ka ya ontuku. Osho molwashono Josua ta galikana Jehova nota ti nduno: ‘Etango, thikama thilu!’ Nuuna etango tali thikama thilu, Aaisrael otaa vulu okumana olugodhi lwawo.

Omu na natango aakwaniilwa oyendji aawinayi muKanaan mboka ye tonde oshigwana shaKalunga. Konyala otashi pula Josua netanga lye oomvula hamano okudhengela aakwaniilwa 31 moshilongo. Konima Josua ota si oshimpwiyu opo oshilongo Kanaan shi topolelwe omazimo ngoka kaage na natango iitendelwa.

Oomvula odhindji otadhi piti po, nokonima Josua okwa si puukokele woomvula 110. Omanga ye nookuume ke ya li ye na omwenyo, oshigwana otashi vulika kuJehova. Ihe sho aalumentu mbano aawanawa ya si, oshigwana osha tameke tashi longo iinima iiwinayi nosha yi muudhigu. Opo tuu mpoka yo oya pumbwa lelalela ekwatho lyaKalunga. Josua 10:6-15; 12:7-24; 14:1-5; Aatokolihapu 2:8-13.

SHO Aaisrael ye ya muudhigu, yo otaa pula ekwatho kuJehova. Jehova okwe ya uvu moku ya pa aawiliki omapenda oku ya kwatha. Ombimbeli otayi ithana aawiliki mbano aatokolihapu. Josua oye a li omutokolihapu gwotango, nayamwe yomaatokolihapu ya landula ko oya li Otniel, Ehud naSamgar. Ihe yaali yomaantu mboka ya kwatha Israel, oyo aakiintu yomadhina Debora naJael. Debora oye omuhunganeki. Jehova ota gandja omayelithilo kuye kombinga yonakuyiwa nopo nduno ye ta hokololele oshigwana shoka Jehova ta ti. Debora naye wo omutokolihapu. Ye oha kuutumba aluhe kohi yomulunga gwontumba moondundu, naantu otaye ya kuye molwomapukululo kombinga yomaupyakadhi gawo.

Jabin ngashingeyi oye omukwaniilwa gwaKanaan. Ye oku na omatembalugodhi agehe kumwe 900. Etanga lye oli na oonkondo ngaaka kutya li thiminike oyendji yomAaisrael ya ninge aapiya yaJabin. Elenga lyiita lyOmukwaniilwa Jabin oSisera.

Esiku limwe Debora ota tumu kOmutokolihapu Barak nota ti kuye: ‘Jehova okwa ti: “Kutha aalumentu 10 000 nou ya fale kOndundu yaTabor. Hoka ngame otandi ku etele Sisera. Ongame notandi ke ku pa esindano u mu sinde netanga lye.”’

Barak ota ti kuDebora: ‘Ngame otandi yi ngele ngoye oto yi pamwe nangame.’ Debora ota yi pamwe, nota ti kuBarak: ‘Ngoye esimano lyesindano ito ke li mona, oshoka Jehova ota ka gandja Sisera miikaha yomukiintu.’ Nosho shoka sha ningwa.

Barak ota zi kOndundu yaTabor oku ka kondjitha aakwiita yaSisera. Ombadhilila Jehova ote eta oshikungulu, noyendji yomaakwiita aatondi otaa si omeya. Ihe Sisera ota londoloka metembalugodhi lye nota yi ontuku.

Konima yokathimbo Sisera ote ya ketsali lyaJael. Ote mu ithana meni note mu pe omahini. Otage mu thethelekitha nombalambala ota kotha a pwila mo. Opo nduno Jael ota kutha omboha yetsali nota mbambalele momutse gwomulumentu nguka omwiinayi. Konima sho Barak te ya, ote mu ulukile nakusa Sisera! Ano ngoye oto vulu okumona kutya shoka Debora a ti osha gwanithwa.

Lwahugunina Omukwaniilwa Jabin ota dhipagwa wo, nAaisrael oya kala uule wokathimbo nombili. Aatokolihapu 2:14-22; 4:1-24; 5:1-31.

MOMBIMBELI ngoye oto ka mona mo embo lyedhina Rut. Olyo ehokololo kombinga yuukwanegumbo mboka wa kala nomwenyo pethimbo ndyono Israel sha li shi na aatokolihapu. Rut oye omukiintu omugundjuka gwomoshilongo shaMoab; ye ke shi gumwe gwomoshigwana shaKalunga Israel. Ihe sho Rut i ilongo kombinga yaKalunga kashili Jehova, ye okwa tameke okukala e mu hole unene. Naemi oye omukiintu omukuluntu ngoka a kwatha Rut oku mu longa kombinga yaKalunga.

Naemi oye Omwiisrael. Ye nomusamane gwe noyanamati yaali oya tembukile koshilongo shaMoab sho muIsrael mwa li iikulya iishona. Esiku limwe omulumentu gwaNaemi okwa si. Konima oyanamati yaNaemi oya hokana naakadhona yaali Aamoab yomadhina Rut naOrpa. Ihe konima yoomvula 10 lwaampono oyanamati yaali yaNaemi oya si. Alikana Naemi naakiintu aagundjuka yaali oya li ya sa oluhodhi ngiini! Nga-shingeyi Naemi ota ka ninga nee ngiini?

Esiku limwe Naemi ota tokola a kuthe olweendo olule okushuna koshigwana she. Rut naOrpa oya hala ya kale puye, notaa yi ano pamwe naye. Ihe sho ye ende ethimbo ele, Naemi ota ti kaakiintu aagundjuka: ‘Shuneni kegumbo nomu ye mu ka kale poonyoko.’

Naemi ote ya laleke nethipo lyokomilungu. Opo nduno otaa tameke taa lili, oshoka yo oye hole Naemi unene. Yo otaa ti: ‘Aawe! Tse otatu yi pamwe nangoye koshigwana shoye.’ Ihe Naemi ota yamukula: ‘Ne omu na okushuna, aamwandje. Otashi ka kala shi li nawa kune okukala kegumbo.’ Ano Orpa ota shuna. Ihe Rut ita shuna.

Naemi ota ti ngashingeyi kuye: ‘Orpa okwa shuna. Shuna pamwe naye kegumbo.’ Ihe Rut ota yamukula: ‘Ino kambadhala u yithe ndje! Etha ndje ndi ye pamwe nangoye. Hoka to yi, ngame oko tandi ka ya naampoka to kala, ngame opo tandi kala. Oshigwana shoye otashi ka kala oshigwana shandje, Kalunga koye oye ta ka kala Kalunga kandje. Mpoka to sile, ngame opo tandi ka sila, nopo mpoka ngame tandi ka fumvikwa.’ Sho Rut e shi ti, Naemi ota mwena oku mu thiminika a shune kegumbo.

Lwahugunina aakiintu yaali mbaka otaa thiki muIsrael. Yo otaa tula moka. Rut ota tameke mbalambala okulonga mepya, oshoka olyo ethimbo lyokuteya iilya. Omulumentu gwedhina Boas ote mu toolitha iilya ye mepya. Owa tseya mbela kutya olye a li yina yaBoas? Okwa li Rahab gwokoshilando shaJeriko.

Esiku limwe Boas ota ti kuRut: ‘Konyala ngame ondu uva ayihe kombinga yoye, nonkene u li nawa naNaemi. Ngame onda tseya nkene ngoye wa thigi po ho nanyoko noshilongo shoye nonkene ngoye we ya okukala mokati koshigwana shoka ngoye inoo shi tseya. Jehova ne ku yambeke!’

Rut ota yamukula: ‘Ngoye owa kala nangame nombili, tatekulu. Ngoye ou uvitha ndje nawa molwashoka owa popi nangame nawa ngawo.’ Boas oku hole unene Rut, nokonima yokathimbo ye ota hokana naye. Alikana Naemi okwa nyanyukwa ngiini kwaashino! Ihe nokuli Naemi okwa nyanyukwa unene sho Rut naBoas ya mono okanona kawo kotango okamati, kedhina Obed. Konima Obed ota ningi hekulu yaDavid, ngono tse natango tatu ki ilonga nale oshindji kombinga ye. Embombimbeli lyaRut.

OU WETE shoka tashi ningwa mpaka? Ayehe oyo aakwiita yaIsrael. Aalumentu mboka taa kotamene oyi ipyakidhila nokunwa. Ngoka a thikama puyo oye Omutokolihapu Gideon. Ye ota tala nkene yo taa nu omeya.

Tala komikalo dhi ili nodhi ili ndhoka aalumentu taa nu omeya. Yamwe otaye eta iipala yawo naanaa sigo opomeya. Ihe gumwe ote eta omeya komulungu gwe noshikaha she opo a vule okutala shoka tashi ningwa momudhingoloko gwe. Osha simana, oshoka Jehova okwa lombwele Gideon a hogolole owala aalumentu mboka ya tonata manga yo taa nu. Kalunga okwa ti kutya oshihupe oshi na okushunithwa kegumbo. Natu tale kutya omolwashike.

Aaisrael oye li ishewe muudhigu uunene. Osho molwashoka yo oya li inaaya vulika kuJehova. Aantu yokuMidian oye ya sindi noye ya ningi nayi. Ano Aaisrael otayi ithana ekwatho kuJehova, Jehova nota pulakene eigidho lyawo.

Jehova ota lombwele Gideon a gongele etanga, ano Gideon ota gongele aakwiita 32 000. Ihe etanga lyaatondi yaIsrael olya thikama maalumentu 135 000. Nonatango Jehova ota ti kuGideon: ‘Ngoye ou na aalumentu oyendji.’ Omolwashike Jehova e shi tile?

Osho molwashoka Aaisrael otashi vulika taa dhiladhila kutya esimano otali ningi lyawo ngele yo oya sindana. Ngiika yo otaa ka dhiladhila kutya yo kaya li ya pumbwa ekwatho lyaJehova okusindana. Omolwashoka Jehova ta ti kuGideon: ‘Lombwela ayehe mboka ya tila ya shune kegumbo.’ Sho ngaa Gideon te shi ningi, 22 000 yomaakwiita ye otaa shuna kegumbo. Ano opwa hupu owala aalumentu 10 000 okukondjitha aakwiita mboka 135 000.

Ihe pulakena! Jehova ota ti: ‘Ngoye ou na natango aalumentu oyendji.’ Ano ye ota lombwele Gideon a nwithe aalumentu pomulonga nguka, naayehe mboka taye eta iipala yawo sigo opomeya okunwa otaa shunithwa kegumbo. ‘Ngame esindano otandi ke li ku pa u na aalumentu 300 mboka ya li ya tonata omanga yo ya li taa nu,’ Jehova tu uvaneke. Ethimbo lyolugodhi olya thikana. Gideon ota topola aalumentu ye 300 moongundu ndatu. Ye ota pe kehe omulumentu enkuma nosho wo oshiyuma mu na onyeka. Lwopokati kuusiku yo otaa kundukidha ontanda yomutondi. Opo nduno otaa hiki oshita omankuma gawo notaa tatula iiyuma yawo notayu uyagana: ‘Egongamwele olyaJehova nolyaGideon!’ Sho aakwiita aatondi taa penduka, oya piyagana noya tila. Yo ayehe otaa tameke okuya ontuku, nAaisrael otaa sindi iita. Aatokolihapu ontopolwa 6 sigo 8.

NGOYE owa ninga nale mbela euvaneko nokonima olya ka ninga edhigu oku li gwanitha? Osho omulumentu nguka mefano a ningi, nosho molwashoka ye e uvite eyeme ngawo. Omulumentu oye ependa omutokolihapu gwaIsrael. Edhina lye oJefta.

Jefta oku li methimbo ndyono Aaisrael itaa galikana we Jehova. Yo otaa longo ishewe iinima ya puka. Ano Jehova ota pitika opo aantu yokuAmmon ye ya ninge nayi. Oshi ithanitha Aaisrael Jehova: ‘Tse otwa yono kungoye. Alikana tu hupitha!’

Oshigwana oshu uvite ohenda kombinga yiinima iiwinayi mbyoka sho sha ningi. Sho otashi holola kutya sho oshu uvite ohenda mokugalikana ishewe Jehova. Ano Jehova ote ya kwatha ishewe.

Oshigwana otashi hogolola Jefta a ka kondjithe Aayamoni aawinayi. Jefta okwa hala noonkondo Jehova e mu kwathe molugodhi. Ano ye otu uvanekele Jehova: ‘Ngele to gandja Aayamoni miikaha yandje, ngame otandi ke ku pa omuntu gwotango ngoka ta zi megumbo lyandje ta hambelele ndje mokugaluka kwandje.’ Jehova ota pulakene keu-vaneko lyaJefta note mu kwatha a sindane. Owa tseya mbela kutya olye ta zi mo tango okutsakaneka Jefta? Oye omwanakadhona epona lye. ‘Akutu, omumwandje!’ Jefta ti igidha. ‘Oto yematithile ndje shike ngeyi! Ihe ngame onda ninga euvaneko kuJehova, noitandi vulu oku li ningulula.’

Tango sho omwanakadhona gwaJefta tu uvu euvaneko lye, naye wo ota ye-mata. Oshoka otashi ti kutya ye oku na okuthiga po he nookuume ke. Ihe ye ota ka longela Jehova moshihupe sho-nkalamwenyo ye metsalihangano lye muSilo. Ano ye ota ti kuhe: ‘Ngele tate owa ninga euvaneko kuJehova, ou na oku li gwanitha.’

Ano omwanakadhona gwaJefta ota yi kuSilo, nota longele Jehova oshihupe shonkalamwenyo ye hoka ketsalihangano. Omasiku gane omvula kehe aakiintu yokuIsrael ohaa yi ye ke mu talele po hoka nohaa nya-nyukilwa pamwe naye. Oshi-gwana oshi hole omwa-nakadhona gwaJefta, oshoka ye omulongeli gwaJehova omwaanawa. Aatokolihapu 10:6-18; 11:1-40.

OWA tseya edhina lyomulumentu omunankondonkondo ngoka inaa kala ko nale? Oye omutokolihapu gwedhina Simson. Simson oonkondo dhe ohadhi zi kuJehova. Nokuli manga Simson inaa valwa, Jehova ota ti kuyina: ‘Meni lyokathimbo ngoye oto ka mona omumati. Ota ka kala omukwatelikomeho mokuhupitha Israel kAafilisti.’

Aafilisti oyo aantu aawinayi mboka ya kala muKanaan. Yo oye na aakwiita oyendji mboka taa ningi nayi lela Aaisrael. Sho oshikando shimwe Simson e li mondjila okuya koshitopolwa shAafilisti, onime tayi kumbu otayi mu tsakaneke. Ihe Simson onime ote yi dhipaga niikaha ye yowala. Ye ota dhipaga wo Aafilisti aawinayi omathele.

Konima Simson ota kwatwa kohole okuhola omukiintu gwedhina Delila. Aapangeli Aafilisti otayu uvaneke okupa Delila iimaliwa 1 100 kehe gumwe ngele te ya hokololele shoka sha ningitha Simson oonkondo ngaaka. Delila okwa hala iimaliwa ayihe mbyoka. Ye ke shi kuume kashili kaSimson nenge koshigwana shaKalunga. Ano ye ota pula Simson a tsitsimika shoka she mu ningitha oonkondo ngaaka.



Lwahugunina Delila ota thiminike Simson e mu hokololele oshiholekwa shoonkondo dhe. ‘Omafufu gandje inaga tetwa nando natango,’ ye ta ti. ‘Okuza kevalo lyandje Kalunga okwa hogolola ndje ndi kale gumwe gwomaapiya ye yi ikalekelwa yedhina Aanasiri. Ngele omafufu gandje oga tetwa ko, ngame otandi ka kanitha oonkondo dhandje.’

Ihe sho Delila te shi uvu, ota kotheke Simson komatundji ge. Opo nduno oti ithana omulumentu e ye a tete ko omafufu ge. Sho Simson ta penduka, ye okwa kanitha oonkondo dhe. Aafilisti otaye ya mo notaye mu fala kondholongo. Yo otaa tsipula mo omeho ge notaye mu ningi omupika gwawo.



Esiku limwe Aafilisti otaa ningi oshituthi oshinene okusimaneka kalunga kawo Dagon, notaye eta mo Simson mondholongo oku mu ninga oshiyolitha shawo. Pokati mpono omafufu gaSimson oga koko ishewe. Simson ota lombwele omumati ngoka e mu kwata koshikaha: ‘Etha ndje ndi pampadhale oongudhi ndhoka dha kwatela po etungo.’ Opo nduno Simson ota galikana kuJehova e mu pe oonkondo, nota kwata oongudhi a dhiginina. Ye oti igidha: ‘Etha ndje ndi sile pamwe nAafilisti.’ Omu na Aafilisti 3 000 moshituthi, nopo nduno Simson ota petama notu undula oongudhi noonkondo dhe adhihe, etungo otali mbonyokele mumwe naantu ayehe mboka aawinayi otaa si. Aatokolihapu ontopolwa 13 sigo 16.

KAKE shi mbela okamati okawanawa? Edhina lyako oSamuel. Omulumentu ngoka a tenteka oshikaha she kombanda yomutse gwaSamuel omusaaseri omukuluntu gwaIsrael Eli. Oyo he yaSamuel Elkana nayina Hanna mboka taye eta Samuel kuEli.

Samuel oku na owala oomvula ne nenge ntano. Ihe ye ota ka kala pamwe naEli naasaaseri yalwe mpaka petsalihangano lyaJehova. Omolwashike Elkana naHanna taye eta gumwe ngoka omushona ngawo okulonga metsalihangano lyaJehova? Natu tale.

Oomvula owala dhontumba dha piti po komeho yaashika sho Hanna a li a yemata. Osho molwashoka ye ka li ta vulu okumona okanona, nokwa halele noonkondo okumona okanona. Sho esiku limwe Hanna a talele po etsalihangano lyaJehova, ano ye okwa galikana: ‘Akutu Jehova, ino dhimbwa ndje! Ngele to pe ndje omumati, otandi uvaneke kutya otandi ke mu ku pa opo a vule oku ku longela uule wonkalamwenyo ye ayihe.’

Jehova oku uvu egalikano lyaHanna, nokonima yokathimbo Samuel okwa valwa. Hanna okwa li e hole okamati ke, nokwa tameke oku ka longa kombinga yaJehova omanga ka li okashona natango. Ye okwa ti komulumentu gwe: ‘Shampa Samuel a koko sha gwana itaa yamu we, otandi ke mu fala ketsalihangano a ka longele Jehova hoka.’

Osho shoka tu wete Hanna naElkana taa ningi mefano. Nomolwashoka Samuel okwa longwa nawa kaakuluntu ye, ye okwa nyanyukwa sho ta vulu okulongela Jehova mpaka metsali Lye. Hanna naElkana ohaye ya omvula kehe okugalikana mpaka petsali lyi ikalekelwa nokutalela po okamati kawo. Nomvula kehe Hanna ohe etelele onguwo ompe kaayi na omaako ndjoka ye a ningila Samuel.

Manga oomvula tadhi piti po, Samuel ota tsikile okulonga metsalihangano lyaJehova, na Jehova nosho wo oshigwana oye mu hole. Ihe oyanamati yomusaaseri omukuluntu Eli, Hofni naPinehas aawinayi. Yo otaa longo iinima yi ili noyi ili iiwinayi, notaa ningitha yalwe ya kale itaaya vulika wo kuJehova. Eli oku na oku ya kutha mo muusaaseri, ihe ye ite shi ningi.

Omugundjuka Samuel iha pitika oshinima kehe oshiwinayi shoka tashi ningwa petsalihangano shi mu keelele okulongela Jehova. Ihe molwashoka opu na aantu aashona ngaaka mboka ye hole Jehova lelalela, opwa piti ethimbo ele Jehova inaa popya nomuntu nando ogumwe. Sho Samuel a koko kashona, tashi landula otashi ningwa po:

Manga Samuel a lala metsalihangano, ewi otali mu pendutha. Ye ota yamukula: ‘Ongame nguka.’ Opo nduno ota thikama nota matukile kuEli nota ti: ‘Owi ithana ndje, ongame nguka.’

Ihe Eli ota yamukula: ‘Ngame inandi ku ithana; shuna mombete.’ Ano Samuel ota shuna mombete.

Oshikando oshitiyali gumwe oti ithana: ‘Samuel!’ Ano Samuel ota thikama nota matukile ishewe kuEli. ‘Owi ithana ndje, ongame nguka,’ ye ta ti. Ihe Eli ota yamukula: ‘Ngame inandi ku ithana, omumati gwandje. Inda owala u ka lale ishewe.’ Ano Samuel ota shuna mombete.

‘Samuel!’ ewi tali ithana oshikando oshititatu. Ano Samuel ota matukile kuEli. ‘Ongame nguka, oshoka ondi na uushili kutya oshikando shika owi ithana ndje,’ ye ta ti. Ngashingeyi Eli oku shi shi kutya oJehova ngoka ti ithana. Omolwashono ta ti kuSamuel: ‘Inda u ka lale ishewe, nuuna te ku ithana ishewe, ngoye ou na okutya: “Popya Jehova, oshoka omupiya gwoye otandi pulakene.”’

Shika osho Samuel ta ti uuna Jehova ti ithana ishewe. Jehova ota hokololele nduno Samuel kutya ye ota ka geela Eli noyanamati. Konima Hofni naPinehas otaa si pethimbo lyolugodhi lwawo nAafilisti, nuuna Eli tu uvu shoka sha ningwa po, ota gu ongali, othingo ye otayi teka nota si wo. Ano oohapu dhaJehova otadhi shilipalekwa.

Samuel okwa koko nota ningi omutokolihapu gwahugunina gwaIsrael. Sho a kulupa, aantu otaye mu pula: ‘Hogolola omukwaniilwa oku tu pangela.’ Samuel ina hala oku shi ninga, oshoka Jehova oye lela omukwaniilwa gwawo. Ihe Jehova ote mu lombwele a pulakene koshigwana. 1 Samuel 1:1-28; 2:11-36; 4:16-18; 8:4-9.
